function.description: Get the count of detected network bugs affecting devices in the network. Use this count tool for questions like 'how many network bugs do I have?', 'how many bugs are detected?', 'how many total network bugs are detected?', 'count catastrophic bugs', or 'count severe bugs'. For any in-my-network, detected, or severity-specific network bug count question, explicitly pass deviceCount: 0 so the count includes only bugs with at least one affected device. Examples: 'How many network bugs do I have?' -> deviceCount: 0; 'Count severe bugs' -> severity: SEVERE and deviceCount: 0. Do not omit deviceCount, because omitting it counts all known bug records including bugs with no affected devices and can return a larger number than the UI.
function.name: api_getCountOfNetworkBugs

deviceCount.description: Return network bugs with affected deviceCount greater than this deviceCount. Use deviceCount: 0 for detected or in-network bug counts so only bugs affecting at least one device are counted.

severity.description: Return network bugs with this severity. Available values : CATASTROPHIC, SEVERE, MODERATE

count.description: Count of detected network bugs affecting at least one device when deviceCount: 0 is provided.
